messages:
luca: Opened docs PR #701 — migration guide for the new tooling workflow (SDK v3 + CLI examples). Need 2 approvals. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/701

anya: Thanks. Does this depend on ff/tooling-api? Release needs to know if docs must wait for canary.

luca: It references the new CLI flag and SDK shapes that are behind ff/tooling-api. Preview link is up, CI fixed one broken link in a follow-up commit.

preview-bot: docs preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/701 (status: success)

felix: Quick review: snippets look fine. One API rename: `timeout_ms` -> `request_timeout_ms` in SDK v3. Also curl example should use header `x-rw-client: rw-cli/3`. I pushed a tiny suggestion.

luca: applied @felix suggestions and pushed. Also moved file under `/2.3/migration/tooling/` and updated front matter: `version: "2.3"`, `status: "beta"`, `exclude_from_nav: true`.

qa-bot: Please add a small "Canary vs Stable" checklist explaining what to do if users are on canary. I'll re-run snippet validation when canary image is available.

luca: added checklist section and a one-line migration summary at top.

anya: PM approval pending QA sign-off. Also please add a single-line changelog bullet we can surface in release notes.

felix: approved (snippets validated locally).

qa-bot: QA pass: validated python and CLI examples against SDK v3. Checklist looks clear. :thumbsup:

rachel: Release note: ff/tooling-api scheduled to canary on 2025-11-15. Docs cutoff for synced content is 2025-11-10 23:59 UTC. Recommend landing under versioned path (as you did) and do not add redirects to top-level before canary.

rachel: Approved from release but HOLD merge until 2025-11-11 04:00 UTC unless you explicitly request earlier merge and notify #release.

luca: Roger. I set hold-merge and added the changelog bullet: "Add migration steps for tooling CLI (beta)". Will wait for the release window.

anya: Approved from PM side. Thanks everyone.

preview-bot: hold-merge label applied on PR #701 (reason: release gating). Reminder scheduled for 2025-11-11 05:00 UTC.

luca: Thanks all — holding merge and will ping #release if anything changes. Closing thread until merge window.
